description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy correlation of different sentence embedding models. The horizontal axis displays the model names: Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy Correlation,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8.  For each model, there are two bars presented side-by-side: a light blue bar labeled “Sentiment Acc.” and a light pink bar labeled “STS Corr.” The “Sentiment Acc.” bars range in height from approximately 0.68 for Unsupervised_SimCSE to 0.76 for 2-Tier SimCSE. The “STS Corr.” bars range in height from approximately 0.66 for Unsupervised_SimCSE to 0.74 for 2-Tier SimCSE. The bars are grouped by model, with the “Sentiment Acc.” bar appearing to the left of the “STS Corr.” bar for each model. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
